title: Fruit By Supergood Peach Blackberry & Raspberry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Peach, Blackberry and Raspberry is a soft and juicy fruit medley. It combines the delicate, sunny sweetness of ripe Peaches with the darker, woodland notes of Blackberry and the bright tang of Raspberry. This layered blend offers a satisfying depth of flavour that is both sweet and refreshing. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is formulated for MTL vaping. It’s ideal for use with Starter vape kits and pod mods, producing dense, satisfying clouds and exceptional flavour clarity. This 100ml shortfill is supplied in a 120ml bottle, containing 100ml of 0mg e-liquid. This leaves the perfect amount of space to add two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to create 120ml of 3mg nicotine-strength e-liquid. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable.
